name: Reverse Return Scroll
description:
Can teleport to one of the following three places.
1. The location where the return scroll was last used
2. The location where you died last
3.  Certain Locations which saved in the game system
4. Teleport to party members
5. Teleport to target area

**How To Use**
When you right click the scroll, you will return to the location selected.

**Restriction**
None

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
